description: Expands a domain's SPF record recursively (include/redirect) like a receiver does and counts DNS-querying terms against the RFC 7208 limit of 10 and void lookups against the limit of 2. Returns per-term lookup costs, problems (permerror causes) and warnings. Deterministic, no AI. Price: $0.001 USDC per call via x402 (Base); the first 5 calls per day per client are free.
name: spf_lookup_count
title: SPF record tree with RFC 7208 lookup and void-lookup counts
